items.function: timing network (C and R of the monostable)
items.reason: function the row names that P2 did not return: IOBoard.md@c25aa86:185 names it: C in a dielectric with a stated temperature coefficient, and R from E96, 50 kOhm to 150 kOhm, set on test. C's drift enters the same window budget as V36 and V37. P2 has no entry. Research.md:28 puts passives in round 2, and the R3 row does not name the timing capacitor. If P6 marks it not round 1, no gap remains.

items.function: inverter on an active-low output enable
items.reason: function the row names that P2 did not return: IOBoard.md@c25aa86:192 (Powered-off isolation, sources PR #167, R3, R4) requires I_off or a 4.7 kOhm series resistor from the enable node. P2 lists only the trigger-path inverter. The output buffer is R4's choice (R4 row), so this inverter exists only if R4 picks a buffer with an active-low enable. R3 or R4 must own it; nothing on the page assigns it.

items.function: heartbeat-node series resistors, links and fail-safe pull-downs
items.reason: function the row names that P2 did not return: IOBoard.md@c25aa86:191 and :193 name the 100 kOhm pull-downs on the trigger input, each OR input and the enable node, the 4.7 kOhm series resistors, and the removable links in the display and trigger branches. P2 has no entry. Research.md:28 puts passives and connectors in round 2, so these are not round 1 unless P6 decides otherwise.
